brief:
French far-left presidential contender Jean-Luc Mélenchon said France may deploy ships to escort civilian flotillas supporting Palestinians, Middle East Eye reported. He vowed "direct action" to assist what he described as citizens in need of aid, framing the potential intervention as a matter of humanitarian principle.

Mélenchon's statement represents a sharp shift in France's stated foreign policy stance, positioning military intervention on behalf of pro-Palestinian causes as a possible course of action under his leadership.
dek: French ships may escort pro-Palestinian civilian flotillas, Mélenchon says France's far-left presidential contender Jean-Luc Mélenchon has said that French ships will, if necessary, escort flotillas of citizens as he vowed "direct action" to come to the aid…
title: Mélenchon pledges French naval escort for pro-Palestinian flotillas
